name: osTicket MCP Server
description: Enables AI-driven management of osTicket helpdesks through natural language, allowing users to reply to, assign, and transfer tickets without requiring API keys. It reverse-engineers the osTicket staff panel to provide full access to ticket operations using session-based authentication.
